prompt:
Task: agro_listing_extract. Read the marketplace message and return ONLY a JSON object with keys: intent (sell|buy), product, quantity, unit, quantity_kg, price, price_basis (per_unit|per_kg|total|null), currency, location, available_from (YYYY-MM-DD or null), quality, contact. Use the product and unit codes from the reference list. Resolve relative dates from the message date. quantity_kg = quantity x kg per unit only when the unit has a fixed weight, otherwise null. Use null for anything the message does not say.
Message date: 2026-11-20
Message: REPLACE WITH A REAL MESSAGE YOU COLLECTED (anonymise the phone number)
context: REPLACE WITH THE SAME 'Product codes ... Unit codes ...' TEXT USED BY gen_marketplace.py (copy it from any generated row)
